args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to all production regions and began failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back:** Reverted checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident:** Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback to v2.3.0.

4. **Verified recovery:** Post-rollback status shows checkout-api healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.

Note: The rollback to v2.3.0 was a previously healthy production version, so no change-manager approval was required.
